title: 第5章 化形而出清理不周第6章 兄妹离去规划未来
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
悠悠百元会，对于洪荒不过弹指一瞬，但对于盘古神殿内那颗积蓄了无穷力量的巨蛋而言，却是一段将潜力彻底转化为实力的关键时期。
这一日，盘古神殿内原本恒定的混沌气流骤然沸腾！
以那颗最为庞大的巨蛋为中心，无形的时空之力扭曲、膨胀，仿佛一个即将诞生的宇宙奇点。
蛋壳之上，那银灰色的空间道纹璀璨到了极致，与时间法则的细微流光交织，引动了深藏于血脉中的力之法则印记。
同时，金、木、水、火、土五行虚影在蛋壳周围轮转显现，风雨雷电诸般异象在神殿内轰鸣闪烁！
“咔嚓——”
一声清脆却仿佛响彻洪荒本源的道音，自盘古神殿内传出，却又被神殿自身的力量隔绝了大半，唯有那冥冥中的大道感应，无法完全屏蔽。
巨蛋之上，一道蕴含无限玄妙的裂缝蔓延开来。
没有惊天动地的爆炸，只有无尽的神光自裂缝中喷薄而出，神光之中，一道身影缓缓凝聚。
其身姿挺拔，仿佛撑开了天地四极；面容俊朗，剑眉星目，兼具了盘古的威严与前世记忆中的那份潇洒从容。
黑发如瀑，自然披散，发梢间有空间涟漪荡漾。
周身道韵天成，既有祖巫血脉的磅礴气血撼动虚空，又有元神清光流转，映照诸法。
正是化形而出的帝江！
作为最纯粹的盘古精血所化，他的根脚自然比那三分元神所化的三清还要更贴近盘古的肉身本源！
此刻出世，顿时引动洪荒天地共鸣！
盘古神殿之外，虽因神殿隔绝，异象不显于外，但冥冥之中，紫气东来三万里，地涌金莲虚影，大道纶音若有若无地赞颂。
这是天地在恭贺又一尊盘古正宗的诞生（此时三清已经出世）！
也就在这一刻，那股浩瀚、至公、冰冷的意志——洪荒天道，再次降临。
但与上次那充满杀毒意味的压迫感不同，这一次的天道意志，更像是一种纯粹的登记与见证。
它扫过帝江，确认其盘古正宗身份，记录其大罗金仙巅峰的修为，感知其身上那浓郁的开天功德与合法合规的根脚来源。

帝江清晰地感受到，天道对他没有任何个人情绪，没有敌意，也没有喜好，只是按照既定的规则运行，承认了他的存在与地位。
“洪荒天道至公，果然不假。”
帝江心中最后一块大石落地，彻底安心下来，“它没有自我意识，只是一个维护洪荒运转的最高程序。
只要不触犯它的核心规则，比如大量毁灭世界、阻碍大势，它就不会针对谁。”
念头通达，帝江周身气息愈发圆融自在。
感受着体内那浩瀚如星海的力量，大罗金仙巅峰的修为稳固无比，甚至能隐隐触摸到那混元金仙门槛！
这出世即巅峰的配置，放眼整个洪荒，还有谁？
帝江低头看了看自己化形后，按照前世审美精心微调过的英俊样貌，满意地点了点头。
“很好，力量与颜值并存，这才是穿越者应有的牌面！”
帝江目光扫过身旁静静悬浮的混沌钟、鸿蒙量天尺，感应着体内已然炼化小半的先天五方旗和五行灵珠，再看向盘古血池中那六个因他之前相助而气息更加纯净深厚的血胎。
一股豪情油然而生。
“洪荒，我帝江，来了！”
“这一世，巫族的命运，由我来改写！
这洪荒的格局，也该变一变了！”
帝江一步踏出，周身空间自然折叠，仿佛整个盘古神殿都在欢迎它们真正主人的苏醒。
content_en:
The Youyou Hundred Dollar Society was only a blink of an eye for the ancient world, but for the giant egg in the Pangu Temple that accumulated infinite power, it was a critical period for completely transforming potential into strength.
On this day, the originally constant chaotic airflow in Pangu Temple suddenly boiled!
With the largest dome at the center, the invisible force of time and space twists and expands, as if a singularity in the universe is about to be born.
On the eggshell, the silver-gray space pattern is extremely bright, intertwined with the subtle flow of the law of time, triggering the imprint of the law of force hidden deep in the blood.
At the same time, the shadows of the five elements of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth appeared in rotation around the egg shell, and various phenomena of wind, rain, thunder, and lightning roared and flickered in the temple!
"Click——"
A clear and crisp sound that seemed to resound throughout the ancient world came from the Pangu Temple, but it was mostly isolated by the power of the temple itself. Only the mysterious avenue induction could not completely block it.
On top of the dome, a crack containing infinite mystery spread.
There was no earth-shattering explosion, only endless divine light spurting out from the cracks. In the divine light, a figure slowly condensed.
His figure is tall and straight, as if the four poles of the world are stretched out; his face is handsome, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, which combines the majesty of Pangu and the coolness and calmness in the memory of his previous life.
The black hair is like a waterfall, spread naturally, with space ripples between the hair tips.
The Dao charm all over the body is natural, with the majestic energy and blood of the ancestral witch's bloodline shaking the void, and the clear light of the soul flowing around, reflecting all dharma.
It is Dijiang who has appeared in form!
As the purest essence and blood of Pangu, his roots and feet are naturally closer to the origin of Pangu's body than the three pure beings transformed by the three-part soul!
When he was born at this moment, it immediately resonated with the whole world!
Outside the Pangu Temple, although the vision was not visible due to the isolation of the temple, in the dark, purple air came from the east thirty thousand miles away, golden lotus shadows surged from the ground, and the sound of the Great Dao was praising vaguely.
This is heaven and earth congratulating the birth of another Pangu Zongzong (Sanqing has already been born at this time)!
At this moment, that vast, supreme, and cold will—the prehistoric way of heaven—came again.
But unlike the oppressive feeling full of anti-virus flavor last time, this time the will of heaven is more like a pure registration and testimony.
It swept across the Dijiang River to confirm its Pangu authentic identity, record its cultivation at the peak of Daluo Jinxian, and sense its rich Open Heaven merits and legal and compliant roots.
Di Jiang clearly felt that Tiandao had no personal emotions, no hostility, and no preference for him. It just operated in accordance with the established rules and recognized his existence and status.
"The great justice of heaven is indeed true."
The last big stone in Dijiang's heart fell to the ground, and he felt completely at ease, "It has no self-awareness, it is just the highest program to maintain the operation of the ancient world.
As long as it does not violate its core rules, such as destroying the world in large numbers and hindering the general trend, it will not target anyone. "
With his thoughts clear, Dijiang's aura became more harmonious and comfortable.
Feeling the power as vast as the sea of ​​stars in his body, the Daluo Golden Immortal's peak cultivation level is so stable that he can even faintly touch the threshold of the Hunyuan Golden Immortal!
Looking at the entire prehistoric era, with this configuration that is at its peak at birth, who else is there?
Di Jiang lowered his head and looked at his handsome appearance that had been fine-tuned according to the aesthetics of his previous life after his transformation, and nodded with satisfaction.
"Very good. Strength and good looks coexist. This is what a time traveler should have!"
Di Jiang glanced at the Chaos Clock and Hongmeng Sky Ruler floating quietly beside him, sensing the half-refined innate five-square flag and five-element spirit beads in his body, and then looked at the six blood fetuses in the Pangu blood pool whose auras were purer and deeper due to his previous help.
A surge of pride arose spontaneously.
"Honghuang, I, Di Jiang, are here!"
"In this life, I will rewrite the fate of the Wu clan!
It’s time for this ancient situation to change! "
Dijiang took one step forward, and the space around himFolded naturally, it seems as if the entire Pangu Temple is welcoming the awakening of their true master.
